description: Per-sample scale-invariant log-depth training loss with exact target-sentinel masking and valid-pixel normalization (Eigen and Fergus, §3.3, Eq. (4); trainer objective dispatch in src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:38-50). Predictions are already log depth.

examples.title: Train a log-depth regressor with scale-invariant loss

name: Scale-Invariant Log Depth Loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts only lambda_; unknown keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: None or a finite real target sentinel matched exactly before logarithms and reductions; every sample must retain a valid target
parameters.lambda_: finite real weight in [0, 1] for the squared summed residual term (default 0.5; paper §3.3 Eq. (4))
parameters.logits_or_prediction: predicted log-depth tensor shaped [B, ...] with finite values at valid targets; each sample is reduced across trailing depth pixels
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per sample [B]; mean or sum reduces per-sample losses (default mean)
parameters.targets: positive finite depth tensor matching prediction shape, dtype, and device; ignored entries are excluded
